name: Anubhav Sanyal
eyebrow: A LITTLE BIT OF EVERYTHING; MOSTLY CODE AND TRAVEL :)
headline: Hi, I’m Anubhav.
tagline: Software engineer building open-source projects, sharing what I learn, and chasing new places along the way.
bio: I’m currently a Senior Software Engineer at National Australia Bank ( NAB ) , working on developer tooling and engineering productivity. I also build open-source projects, speak at conferences around the world, and try to bring back ideas from every place I go.
footer: Build things, meet people, and keep exploring.
